bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (audio client), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/media/audioplayer.rs, springboard/audio/alsa/src/ctl.rs, springboard/src/media/volume.rs, springboard/src/media/route.rs, springboard/src/media/speaker.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/mod.rs
summary: PHASE is a spatial and game audio engine: 3D sources and listener, occlusion, reverb, distance models, sound event graphs and runtime parameters. BifrOSt has a playback and capture service with volume and output routing, but no positional audio, no scene model and no event graph API for apps. The SDK exposes only the playback client.

features.bifrost: springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (one process owns speaker and mic); springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87 (audio::Client); springboard/src/media/engine.rs (Engine, AssetRegistry, UpdateMode)
features.note: The shared playback service and an app-side engine model work: named assets with loop modes, a start and stop lifecycle, and an update mode locked while running, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: the engine does not yet drive audiod, so playing a name is not heard; the lab machine is needed to confirm an asset plays through the server.

Files play through the player and the DAW sampler voices. Loop modes (off, forward, ping-pong) and the read head through a region are in the SDK as bifrost_app::kit::loop_region, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: the player and the DAW voice do not yet take a region from an app, and the sampler voice stays app-internal; the lab machine confirms an audible loop on Midget.

The decoder pipeline streams internally, and an app can push its own sample blocks into a bounded queue with a priority and pull exact-length output with the underrun counted, as bifrost_app::kit::push_queue, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: the player does not yet read from an app's queue and there is no pull-stream callback, so the lab machine is needed for an app's stream to be heard.

features.bifrost: springboard/audio/alsa/src/ctl.rs (ALSA control elements); springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/mod.rs (bus processors); springboard/src/media/mixer.rs (mix, Strip, db_to_linear)
features.note: Layers can be summed through a gain and mute strip with clipping counted, as bifrost_app::kit::mixer, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: there is no signal graph or per-layer parameter set, so the mixer is a flat sum; audio/alsa/src/ctl.rs drives the card's controls, and buses still exist only inside the DAW app.

A per-route volume, a headphone cap and a per-track normalization gain (a target and boost limit, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs) exist. Gap: no loudness analysis of the asset yet, so the measured level must be supplied, and calibration of a device's output needs the lab machine's speakers.

features.feature: Head tracking and personalized spatial audio
features.note: depends on Apple headphone motion and personal HRTF data, which BifrOSt does not have

gaps: No HRTF or head-tracked binaural output: the listener model gives pan gains, distance and occlusion gains only.
SDK exposes only the playback client (springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87); the sampler and buses live inside the DAW app and are not reusable
Occlusion is a transmission gain over boxes (sound_space Occluder); no geometry or material acoustics.
Reverb: sound_room gives reverb time and critical distance, but no applied reverb or environment effect reaches the output.
Groups and ducking: sound_group models a group gain and a ducker, but the audio service applies neither across apps.
